attributes.title: 2027 Oregon Veterinary Conference
attributes.venue: CH2M Hill Alumni Center, Oregon State University
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Oregon Veterinary Conference is scheduled for March 5 to 7, 2027, at the CH2M Hill Alumni Center on the Oregon State University campus in Corvallis. The Oregon VMA's speaker list is grouped into companion animal, lameness, food production and practice leadership topics, plus a separate Technicians & Assistants track.

The first technician-track speakers announced are Megan Brashear, CVT, VTS, and Liza Wysong, CVT, VTS. OVMA says sessions that meet Oregon's required CE topics (anesthesia/analgesia methods and antibiotic stewardship) will be flagged in the session descriptions.

Registration opens in January 2027; fees and total CE hours for 2027 are not published yet.
